name: kxcpicore
title: Will core CPI (month-over-month) for the reference month come in above a given threshold?
settlement: Resolves YES if the seasonally adjusted Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers: All Items less Food and Energy for the reference month, as published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics, increases by more than the stated threshold versus the prior month. The Underlying value used is the single-decimal percentage change reported by BLS. If a federal government shutdown delays the data, the expiration is extended to the earlier of the actual release date or six months after the shutdown ends.
decideContext: You are estimating how a news item shifts expectations for the BLS core CPI (All Items less Food and Energy) seasonally adjusted month-over-month percentage change for the reference month; the market resolves YES if that single-decimal print exceeds the strike threshold, so focus on signals about inflation momentum excluding food and energy, not headline CPI.
